question: does any manuscript claim rest on the 48 episodes the admission rule made unscorable, without saying so
method: every number in the body derived from those blocks was located and its surrounding paragraph checked for language marking the dependency

resolution.not_a_downgrade: these are judge reliability figures, which characterise the instrument rather than score an episode. The admission rule refuses to score an episode whose usage was never measured; it does not forbid using the artifacts to estimate how far a verdict reproduces.
resolution.action: a paragraph was added stating that distinction explicitly, so a reader can see why the variance components are labelled provisional and these are not
resolution.why_not_silence: without the sentence the two sets of numbers look equally supported, and the reader has no way to tell which rest on scores

outcome: no claim was found that rests on an unscorable episode score without a label; one distinction was implicit and is now stated
